**Finding: Compliant** — no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on AP.

- **Searched** for "competing", "compete", "exclusiv", "restrict", "shall not", "Customer shall not", "agrees not to", "will not develop", "solicit". No restrictive covenant binds the Customer.
- **Section 1 (p0001)** affirmatively helps us: it disclaims any exclusive arrangement and states the Agreement "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."
- Other "shall not" clauses bind Kubient (IP non-infringement warranties) or are mutual/neutral; the advertising content standards in p0041 are a compliance undertaking, not a restraint on the businesses AP may operate.

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to flag terms that benefit our party.
